summary: Kerb beside a cleared building site, with a hall and field opposite.
reasons: Opposite side is a hall and open field

drivers.seclusion: West side is a cleared and construction lot (building 8 m, non-residential); nearest mapped dwellings are 15 m (at 50 m) and 7 m at 12 m, both clear of this section. Across the road are a hall and an open field.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed kerb with a parking lane; a car and a van are parked near here, so room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Collector road with steady traffic and a junction at the south end.
drivers.convention: Signed 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted; cars park along this kerb.

flags: Building site may become a house
sun_shade: Open to the sun from the west and north; some tree shade at the north end.
rubbish: Building materials on the lot; no dumped rubbish seen.

best_section.where: Hawken Drive west kerb, along the cleared building site
